_about: Fit score (src/jobhunter/fitgrade.py, rubric.py): each shown job gets 0-100 points by your rubric (skills match 40, visa and location 30, salary and company 30, with the AI engineering culture 20 of those: AI-Native 20, Traditional 0, Unknown 10). Sorting only: it never changes a job's status, never hides or rejects one. The model reads the posting for seniority, required skills, domain, benefits, equity and AI culture, each quoted; code checks the quotes and adds up every part. The salary floors are FIT_SALARY_FLOORS in .env, never here. `enabled` controls the daily run; `jobhunter grade` works either way.
_model: claude-code:opus uses the Claude Code CLI on your Claude login (no API bill, about 20-40 s a job, counts against your plan). deepseek-v4-flash also works (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, about $0.002 a job).
_max_jobs_per_run: A cap per run. The rest wait for the next run or `jobhunter grade`.
_lookback_days: Shown jobs filed under the last this-many days are scored while you have not acted on them (New or Saved).
_interview: When a posting does not show the company's AI engineering culture (AI-assisted coding, product ownership, rapid shipping vs deep language expertise, unassisted coding, algorithm-heavy interviews), the company is looked up once on the web (Claude Code with web search: its engineering blog, careers and how-we-hire pages), its quote checked on the page code fetches, and kept for interview_recheck_days. At most max_interview_lookups_per_run companies a run, best score first.
